windows.command: if (Test-Path .venv) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .venv }; py -3 -m venv .venv; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload

osx.command: rm -rf .venv && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload

linux.command: rm -rf .venv && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload
